1.original_instruction: In the north end of the Archer Village , you need to talk to two NPCs , Arpesto ( pay_arche , 109,169) and Reidin Corse. They will request the following items: 5 Cursed Rubies , 5 Harpy Feathers , 30 Pet Food .

2.original_instruction: Bring them these items, and they will teach you Phantasmic Arrow .

reviews.detail: The request and return describe one 5/5/30 material obligation. Only Arpesto has an explicit coordinate; do not copy it as a verified Reidin Corse point. Both named NPCs participate, but the source does not assign a separate hand-in quantity to each.
